title: WeLike2Party! In-Context Motion Transfer for Multi-Human Image Animation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human image animation aims to transfer motion from a driving video to subjects in a reference image. Despite remarkable progress in video generation, achieving high-fidelity animation of multiple interacting subjects remains a challenge. Many existing approaches rely on explicit motion representations such as 2D skeletons or parametric body meshes and struggle to preserve identity-motion binding under inter-person occlusion. To address this limitation, we propose WeLike2Party, a multi-human animation framework built on direct in-context video conditioning without explicit pose or mesh extraction at inference. We further introduce Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning to preserve fine-grained appearance details, and Identity Binding Supervision to associate each reference identity with its intended motion trajectory. translated_title: WeLike2Party！面向多人图像动画的上下文运动迁移
translated_abstract: 人类图像动画旨在将运动从驱动视频迁移到参考图像中的主体。尽管视频生成领域取得了显著进展，但实现多个交互主体的高保真动画仍然是一项挑战。许多现有方法依赖于显式运动表示（如2D骨架或参数化人体网格），难以在人与人相互遮挡的情况下保持身份与运动的绑定关系。为解决这一局限，我们提出了WeLike2Party，一个基于直接上下文视频条件化的多人动画框架，在推理时无需显式的姿态或网格提取。我们进一步引入了参考非对称RoPE条件化（Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning）以保留细粒度的外观细节，并引入身份绑定监督（Identity Binding Supervision）将每个参考身份与其预期的运动轨迹相关联。为支持跨身份训练，我们构建了MotionTwin，一个包含14.4K跨身份样本的大规模合成数据集……
tldr: 提出WeLike2Party多人图像动画框架，通过直接上下文视频条件化、参考非对称RoPE条件化和身份绑定监督，在无需显式姿态或网格提取的情况下实现高保真多人动画，并构建了大规模跨身份合成数据集MotionTwin。
en_tdlr: WeLike2Party achieves high-fidelity multi-human image animation via direct in-context video conditioning without explicit pose or mesh extraction, introducing Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning and Identity Binding Supervision, along with the large-scale cross-identity synthetic dataset MotionTwin.
